snippet.title: Along Came A Spider (12/29/2009)
snippet.description:
Official description: Along Came A Spider is a 2D platform game. In a world made of silk, you control a small spider trying to find his way back home through twenty dynamic swinging, swaying levels. Your spider will learn amazing new abilities allowing him to catch many more flies along his way. Your fearless spider must also confront his worst nightmares in four special boss levels!

RELEASE DATE: 12/29/2009
DEVELOPER: Raoghard
GENRE: Platformer
Offline players 1
